note: Smith County, KS: arcgis search for zoning returned no services in the county box; web searches found no county or city zoning district layer. Smith Center publishes its zoning ordinance only as a PDF (no district polygons). The Kansas ORKA viewer (experience.arcgis.com) is a parcel/ownership map with no zoning layer I could identify. The 'Smith County' zoning MapServer found in search (smithcountymapsite.org) is Smith County, Texas, not Kansas. Smith County's planning office and other Kansas cities (Kensington, Lebanon, Athol) showed no published zoning GIS.
